title: The open unit cube in Euclid k has volume 1
statement: For every k ∈ ℕ, the open unit cube Q₁^k = {y ∈ Euclid k : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i : Fin k} has Lebesgue measure 1. Here Euclid k = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) with its standard volume, and y_i is the i-th coordinate of y.
lean_statement: ∀ k : ℕ, volume {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} = 1
